top_signals.title: Xi Sits Down With Modi on First Trip to India in Seven Years
top_signals.summary: Xi Jinping met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the Chinese president’s first post-Covid visit to India, as the world’s two most populous nations look to make further headway in stabilizing ties rocked by issues including border tensions.
